stem.text: An object falls freely from rest in a vacuum. The graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ of the object.

stem.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0. A straight line rises from the origin.

stem.text: Which graph, using the same scales, represents the object falling in air?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0. A straight line rises from the origin and ends before the top of the drawing.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0. A curve rises steeply from the origin and then levels off.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0. A curve rises from the origin with decreasing slope.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0. A curve starts flat at the origin and rises increasingly steeply.
